concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it mutates `spec.md`. Parallel execution with any other task that reads the spec could see a partially‑updated file, violating reproducibility. This task must be run exclusively before any consumer reads the spec, so the `[P]` tag is inappropriate.

Task T012 validates contracts after all artifacts have been produced. Running it in parallel with any artifact‑writing task (e.g., T007, T010) would cause intermittent validation failures. Therefore `[P]` is unsafe for T012.
